$comment: The ONLY way a built page, shared asset, media file, font or configuration file may differ from the frozen v0.8 baseline. At Gate 1 the list is empty: the candidate must be byte-identical. An entry needs an id, the file it concerns, a reason, the work package that introduces it, `visual: false` (it changes nothing a visitor or assistive technology perceives), and `normalize` rules (regular expressions applied to the CANDIDATE text before it is compared with the baseline). A `visual: true` entry is refused unless it names an owner approval (APR-JE-nnn) that exists in docs/JADE_AND_EMBER_APPROVALS.md. Pixels, text, computed styles and behaviour are compared regardless of this list.

entries.reason: Approved narrowly scoped accessibility correction for the WebKit text-spacing overlap in the Visit hours table (finding F-G5-04): one @supports rule, effective only in engines that support hanging-punctuation. The normal rendering is pixel-identical to v0.8 in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

normalize.find:
/\*\ Visit\ hours\ table\ \(APR\-JE\-029,\ finding\ F\-G5\-04\)\.\ WebKit\ keeps\ a\ stale\ column\ width\ when\ a\ visitor's\ text\ spacing\ is\ applied\ after\ the\ page\ has\ loaded,\ so\ the\ nowrap\ day\ label\ overflowed\ into\ the\ hours\.\ Only\ engines\ that\ support\ hanging\-punctuation\ \(WebKit\)\ get\ a\ label\ that\ may\ wrap\ and\ is\ never\ narrower\ than\ its\ own\ text;\ every\ other\ engine,\ and\ the\ normal\ state\ everywhere,\ is\ unchanged\.\ \*/\
